purpose: Scaffold, develop, and bundle elaborate multi-component claude.ai HTML artifacts (React 18, Vite, Tailwind, shadcn/ui) into a single HTML file.
use_when: Scaffolding a new claude.ai artifact project with init-artifact.sh for React, Tailwind, and shadcn/ui components
Developing a multi-component artifact requiring state management, routing, or shadcn/ui primitives
Bundling a Vite React artifact into a single self-contained bundle.html with bundle-artifact.sh
do_not_use_when: Designing visual identity, typography, or palette direction for a new UI (use anthropic__frontend-design)
Optimizing React render or bundle performance of existing code (use vercel__vercel-react-best-practices)
Creating a static PNG or PDF poster from a design philosophy (use anthropic__canvas-design)
scope: Only touch files the task names; everything else read-only.
disambiguator: Scaffolding and bundling multi-component HTML artifacts with scripts -> this. Doing visual design direction -> anthropic__frontend-design. Tuning React performance -> vercel__vercel-react-best-practices.
